specs.title: SCN-001.1: Contacts endpoints require a session token (GET /contacts)

steps.title: Given user "A" has a contact "Secret Sam"
[SEED] user A
[SEED] contact "Secret Sam" of hldout-mkz0zbyg-1@example.com
When a client calls GET /contacts without an Authorization header
Then the response status is 401
And the response body is {"error": "Please authenticate."}
And no contact is created, changed or deleted

specs.title: SCN-002.1: A token that was not issued by the application is refused (a made-up token)

steps.title: Given user "A" has signed up
[SEED] user A
When a client calls GET /contacts with "Authorization: Bearer" followed by a made-up token
Then the response status is 401
And the response body is {"error": "Please authenticate."}

Then the response status is 401

specs.title: SCN-003: Signing out ends the session

steps.title: Given user "A" holds a token that returns A's contacts on GET /contacts
[SEED] user A
When user "A" calls POST /users/logout with that token
Then the response status is 200
And GET /contacts with the same token answers 401
And GET /users/me with the same token answers 401

specs.title: SCN-004: A user cannot read another user's contact

steps.title: Given user "A" has a contact "Secret Sam" and user "B" has signed up
[SEED] user A
[SEED] user B
[SEED] contact "Secret Sam" of hldout-mkz2gnsb-3@example.com
When user "B" calls GET /contacts/{id of Secret Sam}
Then the response status is 404
And GET /contacts for user "B" does not contain "Secret Sam"

specs.title: SCN-005.1: A user cannot change or delete another user's contact (PUT)

When user "B" calls PUT /contacts/{id of Secret Sam} with a valid body
Then the response status is 404
And GET /contacts/{id of Secret Sam} for user "A" still returns "Secret Sam" unchanged

specs.title: SCN-006: A new contact always belongs to its creator

steps.title: Given users "A" and "B" have signed up
[SEED] user A
[SEED] user B
When user "A" calls POST /contacts with a valid body that also contains "owner" set to the _id of user "B"
Then the response status is 201
And the new contact's "owner" is the _id of user "A"
And the new contact is listed for user "A" and not for user "B"

specs.title: SCN-007.1: The owner of an existing contact cannot be changed (PUT)

steps.title: Given user "A" has a contact "Secret Sam" and user "B" has signed up
[SEED] user A
[SEED] user B
[SEED] contact "Secret Sam" of hldout-mkz3lwt7-5@example.com
When user "A" calls PUT /contacts/{id of Secret Sam} with a body that sets "owner" to the _id of user "B" (first name, last name and owner)
Then the request is either rejected with 400 or answered 200 with "owner" still the _id of user "A"
And GET /contacts/{id of Secret Sam} for user "A" still answers 200
And GET /contacts for user "B" does not contain "Secret Sam"
